faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about Seedream 4.5 Text to Image

q1.question: What is Seedream 4.5?
q1.answer: Seedream 4.5 is ByteDance's AI image generation model that creates images from text descriptions. It produces photorealistic and stylized images at high resolution.

q2.question: How detailed should my prompt be?
q2.answer: More detail generally means better results. Include subject, setting, lighting, style, mood, and camera angle. Start with a few sentences and add more if needed.

q3.question: What styles can it generate?
q3.answer: Photorealistic, anime, oil painting, watercolor, 3D render, sketch, and more. Specify style in your prompt or reference specific artists and studios.

q4.question: Does it support Chinese prompts?
q4.answer: Yes, Seedream 4.5 understands both English and Chinese equally well. You can write prompts in either language or mix both.

q5.question: What's the difference from GPT-Image-1?
q5.answer: Seedream 4.5 excels at bilingual prompts and multi-image blending (in Image to Image mode). GPT-Image-1 is better for text rendering within images. Choose based on your primary need.
